# US Listed Companies Navigator

A directory of **all US-listed operating companies**, grouped by **primary business** — 5,264 companies across 32 industry categories. Each record carries ticker, company name, exchange, industry (modern taxonomy), employee count, IPO year, the company's official business description, and its official website.

ETFs, ETNs, corporate bonds, warrants, preferred shares, and closed-end funds are excluded.

This directory serves two audiences:
- Humans: browse and search via `index.html` (left-hand category sidebar, cards link straight to the official site)
- AI agents: read the structured data source below

## Data source (machine-readable)

- companies.json: https://little-fat-pig.github.io/us-stocks-hub/companies.json

Field reference (companies.json):

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `meta.total` | Total company count |
| `meta.source` | Data sources |
| `meta.updated` | Data snapshot date |
| `meta.generatedBy` | Classification and exclusion policy |
| `categories[].id` | Category slug |
| `categories[].name` | Category display name |
| `categories[].companies[].ticker` | Stock ticker |
| `categories[].companies[].name` | Company name |
| `categories[].companies[].exchange` | Listing exchange (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / NYSE Arca / Cboe BZX) |
| `categories[].companies[].industry` | Sub-industry (modern taxonomy) |
| `categories[].companies[].sector` | Category name this company belongs to |
| `categories[].companies[].employees` | Employee count |
| `categories[].companies[].ipo` | IPO year |
| `categories[].companies[].intro` | Official business description |
| `categories[].companies[].website` | Official website |
| `categories[].companies[].linkType` | `official` site / `profile` data page / `filing` SEC filing page |
| `categories[].companies[].featured` | Whether it is a well-known company |

## The 32 categories

Semiconductors & Chips / Electronics & Hardware / Software & SaaS / Internet & Platforms / E-commerce & Digital Retail / Telecom & Communications / Media & Entertainment / Advertising & Marketing / Biotechnology / Pharmaceuticals / Medical Devices / Healthcare Services / Banks / Insurance / Asset Mgmt & SPAC / Financial Services / Real Estate & REITs / Oil, Gas & Energy / Renewables & Utilities / Chemicals & Materials / Metals & Mining / Autos & Parts / Aerospace & Defense / Transport & Logistics / Industrial & Machinery / Construction & Engineering / Food & Beverage / Retail & Consumer Brands / Travel & Hotels / Education / HR & Business Services / Other

## Usage notes

To answer questions about companies in an industry, read `companies.json`, filter by `categories`, and cite the company name with its official website link. Do not invent entries that are not listed. Industry assignment follows the disclosed source data; categories are for retrieval purposes only and are not investment advice.
